stem.en: To find a linear circuit's Thévenin equivalent resistance purely from measurements at its two terminals, what do you actually need?
stem.et: Kuidas leida lineaarse ahela Thévenini ekvivalenttakistus ainult klemmidel tehtud mõõtmiste põhjal?

label.en: The open-circuit voltage and the short-circuit current, then divide one by the other.
label.et: Tühijooksupinge ja lühisvool, mis siis omavahel jagada.

label.en: The sum of every resistor's value in the circuit.
The current through whichever load resistor happens to be connected.
The EMF of the internal source, since that alone fixes the equivalent resistance.
label.et: Sisemise allika elektromotoorjõud, sest see üksi määrab ekvivalenttakistuse.
